text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D for gains felt satisfying, but those gains alone don't show whether selling was the best decision; I should consider each trade's effect on the whole portfolio.","Selling Stock E at a gain was consistent with my comfort in locking in profits, but I should avoid letting my reluctance to realize losses determine which stocks I keep.","A few months of account movements offer little guidance about future prices, so I should make deliberate, diversified decisions rather than infer a trend from this short record."]}
